messages.content:
这是一个带有雪花动画的圣诞树 SVG，夜空背景加上灯光点缀，整体会比较有节日氛围。

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 600" width="500" height="600">
  <defs>
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0a0a2e"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#1a1a4e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a2a5e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- 树身渐变 -->
    <linearGradient id="treeGrad1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2d8a4e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a6b35"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="treeGrad2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#35a055"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#228a3a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="treeGrad3" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3eb860"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a9a42"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <!-- 星星光芒 -->
    <radialGradient id="starGlow">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffee88" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ffcc00" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff9900" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- 装饰球光泽 -->
    <radialGradient id="ballRed">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6666"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#ee2233"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#991111"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="ballGold">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffeebb"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#ffcc00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cc8800"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="ballBlue">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#88bbff"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#3366dd"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#112288"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="ballSilver">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#ccccdd"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#888899"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <!-- 灯光发光 -->
    <filter id="glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softGlow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- 夜空背景 -->
  <rect width="500" height="600" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>

  <!-- 雪花 -->
  <g fill="white" opacity="0.8">
    <circle cx="30" cy="80" r="2"><animate attributeName="cy" from="80" to="620" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="120" cy="150" r="1.5"><animate attributeName="cy" from="150" to="620" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="200" cy="40" r="2.5"><animate attributeName="cy" from="40" to="620" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="350" cy="120" r="1.8"><animate attributeName="cy" from="120" to="620" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="420" cy="60" r="2"><animate attributeName="cy" from="60" to="620" dur="8.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="470" cy="200" r="1.5"><animate attributeName="cy" from="200" to="620" dur="11s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="80" cy="300" r="1.2"><animate attributeName="cy" from="300" to="620" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="440" cy="350" r="1.8"><animate attributeName="cy" from="350" to="620" dur="10.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="170" cy="250" r="2.2"><animate attributeName="cy" from="250" to="620" dur="9.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="390" cy="280" r="1.5"><animate attributeName="cy" from="280" to="620" dur="8.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
  </g>

  <!-- 星星光芒（树顶后面） -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="95" r="45" fill="url(#starGlow)" opacity="0.4">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="45;55;45" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- 树冠 - 第三层（底层，最大） -->
  <polygon points="250,180 80,380 420,380" fill="url(#treeGrad1)" stroke="#1a5a2a" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 树冠 - 第二层（中层） -->
  <polygon points="250,130 110,300 390,300" fill="url(#treeGrad2)" stroke="#1a5a2a" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 树冠 - 第一层（顶层，最小） -->
  <polygon points="250,80 140,230 360,230" fill="url(#treeGrad3)" stroke="#1a5a2a" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 树冠纹理 - 下层分支线条 -->
  <line x1="250" y1="180" x2="80" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="180" x2="420" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="220" x2="120" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="220" x2="380" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="260" x2="160" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="260" x2="340" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="300" x2="200" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="300" x2="300" y2="380" stroke="#1a6b35" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- 树冠纹理 - 中层分支线条 -->
  <line x1="250" y1="130" x2="110" y2="300" stroke="#1a8a3a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="130" x2="390" y2="300" stroke="#1a8a3a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="170" x2="140" y2="300" stroke="#1a8a3a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="170" x2="360" y2="300" stroke="#1a8a3a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="210" x2="175" y2="300" stroke="#1a8a3a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="210" x2="325" y2="300" stroke="#1a8a3a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- 树干 -->
  <rect x="220" y="380" width="60" height="70" fill="#6b3a2a" rx="2"/>
  <rect x="215" y="385" width="70" height="10" fill="#7b4a3a" rx="3" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- 树顶金色星星 -->
  <g transform="translate(250, 78)">
    <polygon points="0,-20 5,-7 20,-7 8,3 12,18 0,10 -12,18 -8,3 -20,-7 -5,-7" fill="#ffdd00" stroke="#ff9900" stroke-width="1">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </polygon>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="#ffee55" opacity="0.8">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="8;12;8" dur="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- 装饰球 - 第三层 -->
  <circle cx="150" cy="360" r="10" fill="url(#ballRed)"/>
  <circle cx="145" cy="355" r="3" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="350" r="10" fill="url(#ballGold)"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="345" r="3" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="200" cy="370" r="9" fill="url(#ballBlue)"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="365" r="3" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="365" r="9" fill="url(#ballSilver)"/>
  <circle cx="295" cy="360" r="3" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="375" r="10" fill="url(#ballRed)"/>
  <circle cx="245" cy="370" r="3" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="365" r="8" fill="url(#ballGold)"/>
  <circle cx="96" cy="361" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="400" cy="360" r="8" fill="url(#ballBlue)"/>
  <circle cx="396" cy="356" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- 装饰球 - 第二层 -->
  <circle cx="190" cy="280" r="9" fill="url(#ballGold)"/>
  <circle cx="186" cy="276" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="310" cy="275" r="9" fill="url(#ballRed)"/>
  <circle cx="306" cy="271" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="140" cy="285" r="8" fill="url(#ballSilver)"/>
  <circle cx="136" cy="281" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="360" cy="282" r="8" fill="url(#ballBlue)"/>
  <circle cx="356" cy="278" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="290" r="10" fill="url(#ballSilver)"/>
  <circle cx="246" cy="286" r="3" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- 装饰球 - 第一层 -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="215" r="8" fill="url(#ballRed)"/>
  <circle cx="197" cy="212" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="212" r="8" fill="url(#ballGold)"/>
  <circle cx="297" cy="209" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="225" r="9" fill="url(#ballBlue)"/>
  <circle cx="247" cy="222" r="2.5" fill="white" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- 彩灯（发光圆点） -->
  <g filter="url(#glow)">
    <!-- 第三层灯光 -->
    <circle cx="120" cy="350" r="4" fill="#ff4444"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="170" cy="340" r="4" fill="#ffdd00"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;1;0.3" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="220" cy="350" r="4" fill="#44aaff"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="280" cy="345" r="4" fill="#ff44ff"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;1;0.3" dur="1.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="330" cy="340" r="4" fill="#44ff44"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="380" cy="350" r="4" fill="#ffaa00"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;1;0.3" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <!-- 第二层灯光 -->
    <circle cx="160" cy="270" r="4" fill="#ffaa00"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="1.15s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="220" cy="260" r="4" fill="#ff4444"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;1;0.3" dur="0.95s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="280" cy="255" r="4" fill="#44aaff"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="1.05s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="340" cy="270" r="4" fill="#ffdd00"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;1;0.3" dur="0.85s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <!-- 第一层灯光 -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="200" r="4" fill="#44ff44"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="240" cy="195" r="4" fill="#ffdd00"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.3;1;0.3" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="310" cy="198" r="4" fill="#ff44ff"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;
